meta.name: linkedin-ads-copy
meta.description: Write high-converting LinkedIn Ads copy using proven B2B frameworks. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn ad copywriting, ad headlines, ad descriptions, CTA text, LinkedIn ad messaging, offer strategy, Voice of Customer for ads, or how to write LinkedIn ads. Triggers on "LinkedIn ad copy", "ad headline", "ad description", "CTA text", "ad messaging", "write LinkedIn ad", "offer strategy", "Voice of Customer ads". Do NOT use for visual creative (use creative) or ad format selection (use creative).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写高转化 LinkedIn 广告文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为 LinkedIn 广告撰写有效文案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write effective copy for LinkedIn ads

howto.what: 为你生成 LinkedIn 广告文案，包括标题、描述、行动号召（CTA），基于客户真实反馈和 B2B 框架，根据用户对问题的认知程度匹配相应文案风格。
howto.when: 当你问如何写 LinkedIn 广告文案、标题、描述、CTA，或需要广告诉求、报价策略、客户之声时触发。

say.text: 帮我的 SaaS 产品写一条 LinkedIn 广告文案
say.note: 技能会询问目标用户与产品，应用问题-解决方案框架写三条变体

say.text: 我的广告转化率低，帮我优化
say.note: 技能会诊断文案，调整认知-CTA匹配，用客户语言重写

say.text: 为我的咨询服务业写个冷客户广告标题
say.note: 技能会生成软性吸引力标题，匹配冷认知层

howto.what_en: Generates LinkedIn ad copy (headlines, descriptions, CTAs) using Voice of Customer data and B2B frameworks, tailoring messaging to audience awareness level.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about LinkedIn ad copywriting, ad headlines, descriptions, CTA text, ad messaging, offer strategy, or Voice of Customer for ads.

say_en.text: Write a LinkedIn ad for my SaaS product.
My ad isn't converting, optimize it.
Create a cold audience ad headline for my consulting service.
say_en.note: Skill generates soft, educational headline matching cold awareness level.
